backbone: official LibriSpeech 960h 66.11M streaming Zipformer, FP32, frozen
first_epoch_order: length-sorted for both variants to overlap cache preparation; remaining epochs identically shuffled
initialization: same random initialization for both variants, no AVS or external predictor initialization
gate_label: forecast equals a later acoustically emitted token AND that token is aligned correctly to the reference
alignment: approximate monotonic gold BPE timing from matching native-decoder BPE blocks; unmatched reference positions interpolated; used for offline training labels only
latency: paired stable display gain over native eager display for the same correctly recognized words; simulated arrival clock plus measured added predictor CPU time, not independent phonetic latency
note: Pilot of our method on a strong frozen backbone. No new 960h acoustic training; no FastEmit claim; final transcripts are owned by the native decoder.
